nodes.label: Command authoring form
nodes.rationale: Save a reusable command once and run it anytime; name and command template required, description/tag/cwd optional; {{...}} tokens declare inputs with type {{ to insert inputs.

nodes.label: Live command preview
nodes.rationale: Show rendered command live while authoring so template errors are visible before saving.

nodes.label: Ask-for-values mode
nodes.rationale: Choose Every time vs Once then remember to trade fresh prompting against convenience of remembered values.

nodes.label: Command metadata labels
nodes.rationale: Labels saved with the command describe each input token so run and detail views can render labeled controls.

nodes.label: Run command terminal panel
nodes.rationale: Collect input values then run for real in the shell with live terminal output; no-input commands run as written.

nodes.label: Shell cycle switcher
nodes.rationale: Let the user pick the execution shell (e.g. PowerShell) per run without editing the command.

nodes.label: Raw template versus rendered preview
nodes.rationale: Show both the raw template and the rendered preview plus key-value fields so substitution is auditable before running.

nodes.label: Edit Publish Export actions
nodes.rationale: Keep Edit, Publish, and Metadata JSON export together so a working command flows directly into sharing.

nodes.label: Hub tabbed catalog
nodes.rationale: Separate Commands, Packages, and Package managers tabs so discovery stays scoped per artifact kind.

nodes.label: Community command search palette
nodes.rationale: Palette search with Try suggestions and CLI-rail tool filter to narrow community commands quickly.

nodes.label: Simulated package install catalog
nodes.rationale: Demo catalog where install is simulated and stays in the browser, avoiding real system side effects.

nodes.label: My commands tool and command views
nodes.rationale: Offer Tool View grouped by tool plus Command View flat list, with an add card so empty state still teaches authoring.
nodes.norm_label: my commands tool and command views

nodes.label: Command sort and filter
nodes.rationale: Filter plus Recently Added / Recently Used / Name sort to manage a growing personal command list.

nodes.label: Local real-shell execution note
nodes.rationale: Commands run for real in the user shell while saved values stay on this machine, keeping execution local and private.

nodes.label: Input token guide table
nodes.rationale: Every {{...}} token from Add gets a Try control plus copyable token in an Option / See it / Use table using the same parser as Add; unknown braces stay literal.

nodes.label: Learn filter toolbar
nodes.rationale: Text plus widget-kind filter and match count to find the right input option among file/text/number/date/color/secret/choice/flag/range.

nodes.label: Review submission form
nodes.rationale: Collect author name and email so reviewers can reach the submitter, with optional install script and notes describing what to try first.

nodes.label: Metadata file import lock
nodes.rationale: A .json export from the command page fills and locks the command selection so the reviewed artifact exactly matches the exported file.

nodes.label: Primary navigation tabs
nodes.rationale: Persistent My commands / Community Hub / Learn tabs keep the author-run-discover-learn loop one click away.
